logic_checks: Closure starts from complete wholeword strings and empty; each common residual has two sound left/right parent pairs from the previous round. Index additions occur only after each round, so proof DAG remains acyclic.
Every derived string is a substring of an initial word. The explicit node bound and finite universe prevent unbounded semantic search. Partial closure is never reported exact.
GeneralUD obligation proof does not assume one-sided cancellation or prefix freedom. Nonempty codewords force a one-unit codeword-product to be a singletonentry.
Each omission construction has appropriate endpoint absence, nonempty codes, prefix/suffix freedom and complete source coverage. It contains every already-forced singleton and omits its target.
Validator independently parses raw working units and rebuilds FULL/GE2word supports; complete closures compared against an independently computed fixed point.
Validator verifies all proof parents, source roots, countercode shapes, freeUD via residuals, and exactlyone dynamic-program parse of each whole type; usage counts and activity rebuilt.
The forced set is exact only when closurecomplete and every nonderived target has an omission certificate. Per-target countercodes do not imply joint omission or codebook-size optimality.
A complete group made only of forcedsingletons has an all-singleton parse and hence no competing longer parse under freeUD. Its activity is conditional segmentation, not phoneme/meaning evidence.
Named fixtures cover false one-sided cancellation, nonUD collision, nonbifix UD, and unresolved ab/ba. Exhaustive short binary endpoint-compatible examples exercise both omission directions.
